page.layout: One page of text, in one column. Musical notation figures stand on their own lines between the text lines. No marginal notes. Running head at top, page number at top right, gathering signature at foot.

main_text.head: Cedò regulam mediarum?

p.i: Quælibet è medio brevis est, una excipienda, scilicet quæ sequitur initialem, & in sinistro latere caudā sursum protendit.

main_text.head: Cedò regulas Finalium.
main_text.p: Ultima conscendens brevis est quæcunque ligata, [illegible, ~6 letters]
Ultima dependens quadrangula sit tibi longa, [illegible, ~6 letters]
Excipitur caudam tollens ex parte sinistra, [illegible, ~8 letters]
main_text.head: Quid est Signum Silentii.

p.i: Signum silentii est pausa, tempus silen-tio metiens.

page.notes: The musical signs (neumes or rhythmic figures) are printed as graphic symbols in the text lines, not as letters. Each is marked as illegible: one after the first rule, two after "Ultima conscendens" and "Ultima dependens", one after "Excipitur caudam tollens", and the sign-line counts are approximate. The signature "Z 4" at the foot is uncertain. Faint show-through of the reverse page appears at the lower left and is not transcribed. The "Cedò" and "Quid est" lines are centred roman lines, treated as level 2 headings.
